# Sanota Global (Sanota Pvt Ltd)

> Sanota is an integrated multidisciplinary engineering technology partner delivering industrial machinery retrofitting, industrial automation, tea processing automation, smart agriculture systems, and IoT solutions.

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Industrial Automation & PLC/SCADA**: Turnkey industrial control panel design, assembly, PLC retrofitting (Siemens, Schneider, Omron, Delta), SCADA and HMI integration, motor speed control, variable frequency drives (VFD), and conveyor automation.
- **Machinery Modernization & Retrofitting**: Mechanical fabrication, obsolete control panel replacement, hydraulic/pneumatic retrofitting, and extending equipment lifespan without the high cost of replacement.
- **Tea Process Automation**: Automated tea trough withering humidity and temperature control, fluidized bed tea dryer retrofits, tea factory SCADA monitoring, and leaf handling conveyors.
- **Smart Agriculture & AgTech**: Commercial greenhouse climate control, automated fertigation and precision dosing systems, EC/pH monitoring, and remote IoT farm dashboards.
- **Industrial IoT & Digital Transformation**: Factory telemetry, remote machinery monitoring, predictive maintenance sensors, and custom operational web/mobile dashboards.
- **Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)**: Preventive and corrective maintenance, calibration, emergency troubleshooting, and technical SLA support.
